Scientific Realism: IBE, No-Miracles, Anti-Realism, van Fraassen, Structural Realism

sections.text: The central question: do theoretical entities posited by successful science — electrons, quarks, electromagnetic fields, spacetime curvature — actually exist, or are they useful fictions that happen to generate correct predictions? The debate between scientific realism and its rivals is the most active area in philosophy of science today.
